description: The Smplrspace 3D Viewer brings your floor plans into Power BI as interactive space models. Visualize your data in 2D, 3D, or on a map — from a single room to an entire portfolio of buildings — and let your team explore KPIs, occupancy, asset status, and more anchored to the exact locations they relate to. No technical setup, no coding — just your data, in space. Who is this for This visual is built for the operational and commercial teams who live in the real world of physical spaces: facility managers, operations teams, leasing teams, real estate analysts, and enterprise BI teams. If your day involves managing occupancy, tracking assets, monitoring conditions, or making decisions about how space is used or leased — this visual puts your Power BI data exactly where you need it. No developer required. The problem it solves Traditional Power BI visuals show data without spatial context. Knowing that a floor is at 80% utilization, that 12 assets are offline, or that three units are available for lease tells only half the story. Ops and leasing teams need to know which rooms, which zones, and which areas — and act on that information fast. The Smplrspace 3D Viewer closes that gap, letting non-technical users instantly see where performance issues, bottlenecks, or opportunities are located, all without leaving their Power BI report.
